disclosure: Six new AI-assisted pixel-art illustrations, not handwritten drawings and not documentary photographs. Licensed architectural references retained; no commercial-game assets. Not an emulation of original NES hardware palette/tile limits.
runtime: Only these local native PNGs; no generation, Internet, external models, master files or source photographs needed to draw the NES background.
palette: At most 64 colours per background; the independently licensed LPC characters retain their own palettes.
